Name: Leelo's Cats
Author: LeeloMods
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Description
[/b][/size][/center]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds several customized cats to the game, including a tuxedo cat, tortoiseshell cat, an orange cow cat, and a brown tabby cat. These cat sprites will be used in a future mod I am working on. For now, I figured I would share these sprites in case anyone likes them!  Hats are fully functional with these cat sprites! [/color]

[center][size=4][b]Installation instructions
[/b][/size][/center]
[color=#d4d4d8]Download with a mod manager for automatic installation. For manual installation, download the .zip mod folder into the StardewValley\Mods folder, extract all from the .zip folder into the same location (StardewValley\Mods) and you are all set.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]You do [b]not[/b] need to start a new game. Added cats can be adopted from the start or from Marnie's shop later on.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Each cat sprite has their own standalone mod that can be found on my Nexus profile.[/color]

[color=#ff00ff]Remember to endorse the mod! This helps with visibility, allowing even more Stardew players to enjoy my content[/color]

[center][size=4][b]Meet the Models[/b][/size][/center]

[center][img width=400,height=400]https://i.imgur.com/fzvTrDf.jpeg[/img]
Dean is a 9 year old brown tabby. He is very shy, but very sweet once he becomes comfortable around you. He was adopted from a local animal shelter when he was 6 years old after his previous owner was evicted from their home. He loves food, getting brushed, and tummy pets.[/center]
[center]

[img width=400,height=400]https://i.imgur.com/9C3pxMd.jpeg[/img]
Phoebe is a 10 year old tuxedo cat who has had a rough life. She was rescued as a two month old kitten. After a few years, her human dad (her favorite person) passed away. Not too long later, her human mom passed away and she, and her dog and cat siblings, were taken to the local animal shelter. Luckily, Phoebe was adopted by my friend, the daughter of Phoebe's human parents. She loves drinking from the sink, getting brushed with a hairbrush, laying in the sun, and treats.[/center]


[center][img width=400,height=400]https://i.imgur.com/5XyrNmJ.jpeg[/img]
Cookie Dough is a beautiful Persian cat with a tortoiseshell coat. She is one year old and has the energy and curiosity to prove it. Her human mom was moving houses so Cookie Dough has been temporarily living with my friend while her mom gets settled. Cookie Dough has quickly become a loved member of the family. She can often be found playing with Phoebe, the tuxedo cat. She loves playing with q-tips and causing trouble around the house. [/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img width=400,height=600]https://i.imgur.com/NgQFbVm.jpeg[/img][/center]
[center]Miles, the orange cow cat, is a very shy boy, often running and hiding from strangers. When he gets used to someone new, he quickly demonstrates just how sweet he is. He enjoys cuddles, playing with his dog sister Daisy, and food.
[/center]
